description: This file defines classes and functions for handling WebSocket extensions, including deflate, permessage-deflate, and multiplexing extensions. It manages extension negotiation, stream options setup, and compression ratio logging.

classes.name: ExtensionProcessorInterface
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket extension processors, managing activation state and response generation.

classes.name: DeflateFrameExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Handles deflate-frame extension processing, including negotiation and stream filtering.

classes.name: PerMessageDeflateExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Handles per-message deflate extension, including negotiation, framing, and compression/decompression.

classes.name: CompressionExtensionProcessorBase
classes.description: Base class for perframe and permessage compression extensions, managing method negotiation.

classes.name: _PerMessageDeflateFramer
classes.description: Manages framing for per-message deflate extension, including compression and decompression of messages.

classes.name: MuxExtensionProcessor
classes.description: Handles WebSocket multiplexing extension, including quota management and extension negotiation.

classes.name: ExtensionProcessorInterface
classes.description: Base class for extension processing, providing common interface and activation control.

methods.name: get_extension_processor
methods.description: Creates and returns an extension processor instance based on the extension offer received.

methods.name: is_compression_extension
methods.description: Checks if a given extension name is a supported compression extension.
